caption: The drawing contains two sets of jewelry items, each accompanied by its respective line drawing to the right. The upper left object is a horizontal gold bar with rounded ends, connected in the center by a vertical rectangular segment adorned with floral and geometric patterns. Hanging from the bottom of this bar are three elongated, teardrop-shaped gold pendants. To the right of this item is a black line drawing representation of the same object, focusing on its contour and main shapes. Below, the second object is a vertical arrangement, centered on a large round gold knob at the top, attached to a horizontal gold bar with two smaller round elements at its ends. Three teardrop-shaped gold pendants hang below: two smaller ones directly beneath the sides and a longer, decorated teardrop with engraved patterns, hanging from the central bottom. To the right of this is a black line drawing, depicting the object in simplified outline form. The background of the drawing is a light beige color. At the bottom center, the words "TWICE ACTUAL SIZE" are printed in capital letters.
title: Brooch and Earrings
